tick.wurst

Tool

tick.wurst is a pomodoro timer that remembers your streaks between sessions, all stored inside the file itself.

What it shows off

  • A small utility app with persistent state and no backend
  • Fast slice-by-slice reads on launch, since .wurst isn't a zip container
